python3 -B - <<'PY'
import http.client,json,subprocess,pathlib,unittest,sys
print("ACTION=MEDIA_SAVE_FULL_FALLBACK_OFFLINE_E2E")
try:
 root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
 bin=root/"dist"/"data"/"media-extractors"/"bin"
 for tool,version,keywords in (("gallery-dl","1.32.19",("--post-range","--filter","--filesize-max")),("yt-dlp","2026.10.26",("--no-playlist","--max-filesize","--extractor-retries"))):
  exe=bin/tool
  assert exe.is_file() and exe.stat().st_mode & 0o077==0,"PRIVATE_BINARY_MISSING"
  check=subprocess.run([str(exe),"--version"],capture_output=True,timeout=15)
  assert check.returncode==0 and version.encode() in check.stdout,"PINNED_VERSION_MISMATCH"
  flags=subprocess.run([str(exe),"--help"],capture_output=True,timeout=20)
  assert flags.returncode==0 and all(x.encode() in flags.stdout for x in keywords),"CLI_OPTIONS_MISSING"
 conn=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",8081,timeout=8)
 conn.request("GET","/healthz")
 response=conn.getresponse();health=json.loads(response.read(16000));status=response.status;conn.close()
 assert status==200 and health.get("commit")=="fd6e335fad77f1742573bfb37c588298c62267e0","LIVE_SHA_MISMATCH"
 for method,path in (("GET","/media/jobs"),("POST","/media/save"),("GET","/media/file/"+"0"*32)):
  conn=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",8081,timeout=8)
  conn.request(method,path);response=conn.getresponse();code=response.status;response.read(1000);conn.close()
  assert code==401,"OWNER_GUARD_FAILED"
 suite=unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover("tests",pattern="test_*.py")
 with open("/dev/null","w") as out:
  result=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=out).run(suite)
 assert result.wasSuccessful() and result.testsRun>=150,"OFFLINE_TESTS_FAILED"
 print("LIVE_SHA=PASS")
 print("GALLERY_DLP_PINNED=PASS")
 print("YTDLP_PINNED=PASS")
 print("OWNER_ACCESS_GUARDS=PASS")
 print("TEST_COUNT="+str(result.testsRun))
 print("PROVIDER_TRAFFIC=NONE")
 print("VERIFY=PASS")
except Exception as exc:
 print("VERIFY=FAIL")
 print("ERROR_TYPE="+type(exc).__name__)
 sys.exit(42)
PY
